evaluationLandingPage: Official evaluation entrypoint verified either from a hash-checked archived page or an explicitly labeled official-page review. This is not proof of downloading its linked reports.
evaluationType: Conservative lexical source scope: business/project, policy, facility, education inspection, mixed or unknown. This is not a complete municipal business-evaluation claim.

historicalReferenceCounts.definition588: Distinct municipality codes with at least one acquired source tagged official_host_identity_and_evaluation_text by the previous reconciler; the wording may be on a parent page and does not establish substantive readable evaluation documents.
historicalReferenceCounts.definition688: Distinct municipality codes with artifactValidation=verified in the frozen normalized-document inventory. Includes identity-rejected/supporting sources.

officialFallback: Observed homepage links from verified official pages; otherwise the exact municipal open-data page recorded by the Digital Agency directory. Never a guessed root URL.
reviewedNavigation: Additional links reviewed through official page content; marked separately. No original bytes or full text stored; sourceSha256 is null and acquisition is discovered/blocked. Search-only and delegated-host identity-pending links remain candidates.
scope: Japan municipalities; excludes the 47 prefectural governments.
searchStatus: The input finite initial-look status; searched_not_found is not unpublished and no status means exhaustive discovery.
sourceVerification: Exact municipality identity plus official host with duplicate-name disambiguation, unique official-directory municipal host, or literal same-city official parent link. Explicit negative identity claims excluded. Every acquired source hash and byte size independently recomputed offline.
substantiveEvaluationText: Acquired, identity-verified evaluation-document bodies, including explicitly reviewed substantive HTML project tables as well as non-HTML documents. Landing pages and supporting guidelines are excluded. This is unstructured source access, not complete or numerically normalized coverage.
textSanitization: Visible text only; scripts/forms/hidden content, semantic navigation/sidebar/footer, apparent credentials/configuration lines and contact telephone lines excluded. Email addresses and long token-like IDs redacted. Sanitized codepoint counts and truncation are explicit.
unstructuredText: Text of public official sources, sanitized and capped. Table associations are not normalized. Formatting may be imperfect. Current source URLs can have changed since the offline acquisition.
urlNormalization: HTML character entities in URL attributes are decoded; fragments are removed. No hostname or path is guessed.
years: Only explicit source-title, official anchor-label or printed text labels. Calendar conversion of an era is mechanical. Fiscal years mentioned are not silently treated as evaluation years. No current-date or filename inference.
